notes.title: (DLC is release) NTR Wife -Yukiko- 20 Years After Marriage, End of The Story
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805355/1c955b63c67e122ed006cb3b0594dfdba9e87c6f.png
----New DLC Released!
Netorare Wife -Yukiko-: 20 Years After Marriage, End of The Story is now available!

Dive into the emotional conclusion of Yukiko’s story — set 20 years after the events of the main game. This DLC delivers a deeper look into the consequences of her choices, the memories she carries, and the life she now leads.

----New Features:

~A brand new chapter continuing Yukiko’s journey

~Updated character art style exclusive to the DLC

~Consisting of 10 scenes (The duration is almost like 20 scenes in the base game).

~New scenes, CGs, and emotional storytelling

~This DLC will be updated in the next major update, where there will be a new story or spin off.

Thank you for your continued support. We hope this final chapter gives you the closure you’ve been waiting for.

👉 Available now on Steam!

--------------------------------------------
